annotations.title: Remove drawings from my open Vela chart

description: Removes drawings an assistant or Quant, our coding agent, made on the chart the signed-in member has open right now in Vela: the groups named (a group vela_mark_up_chart or vela_draw_on_chart returned), or all of them. It never touches the member's own drawings. Use it to clear an analysis before drawing a new one, or when the member asks to clean up what was drawn for them. With the member's Vela tab on screen it happens in front of them within seconds. When it is not (they are in another tab), the change is queued and applied the moment they look at Vela again, within 10 minutes: the result then says queued, so tell them to open Vela. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

all.description: Remove every drawing an assistant or Quant made on the chart.

all_charts.description: Do it on every chart of the layout, not only one.

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

groups.description: Groups to remove, as vela_mark_up_chart or vela_draw_on_chart returned them.

slot.description: One chart of a multi-chart layout, by position (0 is the top-left, in reading order). Leave it out for the chart the member is working on.
